assumptions.statement: Part 1 exterior wall thickness is currently estimated at about 0.5 m.
assumptions.why_it_matters: Wall thickness affects U-value reasoning, opening details, material quantities and CAD seed accuracy.
assumptions.required_verification: Measure a representative reveal at a window or exterior door.

assumptions.statement: Existing roof build-up, ventilation and underlay/sarking are unknown.
assumptions.why_it_matters: Roof insulation and PV decisions can fail if moisture behavior and structural build-up are misunderstood.
assumptions.required_verification: Inspect attic/roof build-up and document with S11-S14 photos.

assumptions.statement: Side-elevation terrain lines are simplified reasoning aids, not measured site profiles.
assumptions.why_it_matters: Drainage, plinth moisture and threshold decisions depend on real local ground levels.
assumptions.required_verification: Check threshold, plinth and local fall with photos and quick level/laser measurements.

assumptions.statement: Keller is assumed near the southernmost Part 1 corner and roughly follows the main building direction.
assumptions.why_it_matters: Moisture diagnosis, structural context and deconstruction planning depend on cellar extent.
assumptions.required_verification: Confirm cellar access, vault direction and approximate 4 m x 7 m dimensions.

measurementNeeds.description: Measure representative exterior wall thickness at a window or door reveal.
measurementNeeds.reason: Replaces the current 0.5 m wall estimate with measured evidence.
measurementNeeds.suggested_method: Use tape/laser at an open reveal and photograph the measurement.

measurementNeeds.description: Identify roof covering, underlay/boarding, ventilation path and visible timber structure.
measurementNeeds.reason: Roof insulation, PV and moisture risk depend on existing build-up.
measurementNeeds.suggested_method: Use S11-S14 photo blocks, measure one rafter bay and document visible layers.

measurementNeeds.description: Verify eaves, ridge, threshold and terrain relationships.
measurementNeeds.location_or_component: Part 1 side elevations A-01 and A-02
measurementNeeds.reason: Current side-elevation dimensions are generated from the model and need site control.
measurementNeeds.suggested_method: Laser-distance photo blocks plus one reliable vertical or diagonal control where safe.

measurementNeeds.description: Document all gutter/downpipe discharge points and ground fall at plinth zones.
measurementNeeds.reason: Moisture-control priority depends on actual water paths.
measurementNeeds.suggested_method: Photo walkaround after rainfall if possible; note discharge type and ponding.

measurementNeeds.description: Confirm Keller size, vault direction, entrance and moisture pattern.
measurementNeeds.reason: Cellar evidence influences moisture diagnosis and structural assumptions.
measurementNeeds.suggested_method: Use S18-S19 photo blocks and rough tape/laser dimensions if safe.

risks.description: A roof insulation build-up could trap moisture if ventilation and existing layers are misunderstood.
risks.mitigation: Inspect roof build-up, document ventilation paths and validate with an energy consultant.

risks.description: PV suitability could be overestimated if roof condition, obstructions and maintenance zones are not verified.
risks.mitigation: Verify roof surfaces, setbacks, windows, penetrations and structure before layout decisions.

risks.description: Plinth or Keller moisture could be misclassified without drainage and rainfall evidence.
risks.mitigation: Document drainage discharge, splash zones, Keller moisture and terrain fall.

risks.description: Generated roof and dormer/overhang concepts do not prove structural feasibility.
risks.mitigation: Treat geometry concepts as discussion aids and require structural expert validation.

risks.description: Reuse potential could be overstated before material condition and deconstruction constraints are inspected.
risks.mitigation: Classify retained/removed/reusable elements only after photo and condition evidence.
